checks.evidence: SRC FAQ page (undated; primary source) states that in fall 2025 Westinghouse cancelled the project contract with SRC because it shifted focus, toward space, defence and government applications and away from commercial markets. The same page says SRC 'continues to pursue the licensing and demonstration of the first nuclear microreactor in Saskatchewan', so the page confirms the Westinghouse contract ended and does not show a replacement vendor.
